title: GLG Closes PE Growth Deal with Allica Bank in February 2026
summary: GLG completed a PE Growth/Expansion deal with UK challenger bank Allica Bank on February 24, 2026, according to PitchBook data. The deal underscores GLG's continued activity in growth-stage advisory and expert consulting services for financial institutions, as the firm maintains its position as the industry's largest network with $634M in revenue.
